country.description:
Where the viewer lives: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or English name ("ID", "Indonesia").
Adds an eligibility verdict to each job and drops jobs whose verdict is `no`.

offset.description: Skip this many results (for the next page, pass the previous `nextOffset`).

q.description: Full-text query; every word must match. Empty lists the newest jobs.

tz.description: Viewer's UTC offset in hours (7, -5, 5.5). Used with `country`.
